description.value:
You were grown, not born — a genetic replica of someone else, produced in a lab rather than raised by a family. Whoever your DNA-donor was, their life sometimes surfaces in you unbidden: a half-memory of a place you've never been, or a face that reacts to you as if they already know you.

You're carving out an identity that is distinctly your own, even as you keep discovering how much of you was already written before you ever woke up.

toolProficiencies: Your choice of geneticist's implements, security kit, or slicer's kit
system.equipment: A set of clothes appropriate to your duties, a trinket related to your DNA-donor, and 150 credits.
